abstract: In this study, we analyze a symmetric policy game in a two-country model in which domestic policy affects a Ricardian comparative advantage. Considering a two-good, one-factor set-up in which each country's government provides a productive public good, we show that ex ante identical countries under free trade always choose different levels of public goods in the Nash equilibrium – meaning symmetry-breaking always occurs. We also examine how our analysis is modified in the presence of trade costs and in a multi-good set-up. Moreover, we present a more elaborate model with input–output linkages and entry regulation in an upstream market as an application.
abstract_zh: 在本研究中，我们分析了一个两国模型中的对称政策博弈，其中国内政策影响李嘉图比较优势。考虑一个两商品、单要素的框架，其中每个国家的政府提供生产性公共物品，我们证明，在自由贸易下，事前相同的国家在纳什均衡中总是选择不同水平的公共物品——即对称性破缺总是发生。我们还考察了贸易成本的存在以及多商品框架下我们的分析如何被修正。此外，我们提出了一个更精细的模型，包含投入产出关联和上游市场进入规制，作为应用。

title: Endogenous comparative advantage via symmetry‐breaking policy equilibrium

abstract: This paper examines the effect of corporate tax avoidance (CTA) on U.S. firm-level sales and its aggregate implications. In theory, CTA gives a competitive edge to avoiding firms, which affects the distribution of sales in the economy. In practice, we find a causal impact of CTA on firm-level sales using a broad set of measures of tax avoidance and different identification strategies. Combining microestimates and the model, we assess how changes in CTA over the past two decades have shaped the distribution of sales across U.S. industries. Although the effects vary by sector, rising CTA among large firms has reinforced their dominant positions, contributing to increased concentration, in several key industries. This paper was accepted by Maria Guadalupe, business strategy. Funding: Financial support from the ENS Paris-Saclay Booster’s program, from the SSHRC [Insight Development Grant 207-2018-2019-Q1-00406], from the UQAM research chair on the local impact of multinationals, and from the Fonds de la Recherche Scientifique – FNRS [Grant No. F.4533.23] is gratefully acknowledged. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05773 .
abstract_zh: 本文考察了企业避税（CTA）对美国企业层面销售额的影响及其总体效应。理论上，企业避税为避税企业带来竞争优势，从而影响经济中销售额的分布。在实证上，我们使用一套广泛的避税衡量指标和不同的识别策略，发现企业避税对企业层面销售额具有因果影响。结合微观估计与模型，我们评估了过去二十年间企业避税的变化如何塑造了美国各行业销售额的分布。尽管影响因部门而异，但大型企业避税程度的上升强化了其主导地位，在若干关键行业中推动了集中度的提高。本文由Maria Guadalupe（商业战略方向）接收。资助：感谢ENS Paris-Saclay Booster项目、SSHRC［洞察发展基金207-2018-2019-Q1-00406］、UQAM跨国公司地方影响研究讲席以及Fonds de la Recherche Scientifique – FNRS［基金号F.4533.23］提供的资助。补充材料：数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05773获取。
publisher: Institute for Operations Research and the Management Sciences (INFORMS)
title: Corporate Tax Avoidance and Sales: Microevidence and Aggregate Implications
title_zh: 企业避税与销售：微观证据与总体影响

abstract: Abstract Prior research suggests that students exposed to domestic violence impose substantial negative externalities on peers’ learning and labor market outcomes. We test whether these findings generalize using nine-years of student data from a large urban school district linked to geocoded police records of at-home violence. In contrast to prior work, we find negligible peer effects. Adding one exposed peer to a classroom of 20 students reduces English and math scores by a statistically insignificant 0.006 standard deviations and increases disciplinary incidents by 3.2%. We reject achievement reductions greater than 0.017 standard deviations and disciplinary increases larger than 8.3%.
abstract_zh: 先前研究表明，遭受家庭暴力的学生会对同伴的学习及劳动力市场结果产生显著的负面外部效应。我们利用一个大城市学区九年的学生数据，结合地理编码的警方家庭暴力记录，检验这些发现是否具有普遍性。与先前研究相反，我们发现同伴效应微乎其微。在一个20名学生的班级中增加一名受暴露同伴，会使英语和数学成绩下降0.006个标准差，但统计上不显著，同时纪律事件增加3.2%。我们排除了成绩下降超过0.017个标准差及纪律事件增加超过8.3%的可能性。
title: Reconsidering Peer Effects from Schoolmates Exposed to Violence at Home
title_zh: 重新审视家庭暴力暴露同伴的同伴效应

abstract: Abstract Entry into many occupations is regulated to screen out the least able candidates, but available evidence suggests that this objective is rarely achieved. Using microdata covering the universe of Italian law school graduates (2007-2013), we show that this result is largely due to the strong intergenerational transmission of occupations within regulated professions. We find that having relatives already active as lawyers significantly increases the probability of passing the entry exam and boosts earnings, particularly for those who performed poorly in law school.
abstract_zh: 许多职业的准入受到监管，旨在筛选出能力最弱的候选人，但现有证据表明这一目标很少实现。利用覆盖意大利法学院毕业生总体（2007-2013年）的微观数据，我们表明这一结果在很大程度上归因于受监管职业内部强烈的代际职业传承。我们发现，已有亲属从事律师职业显著提高了通过入职考试的概率，并提升了收入，尤其是对法学院表现不佳者而言。
title: Quality and selection in regulated professions
title_zh: 受监管职业中的质量与选择

abstract: We present new evidence on the long-run evolution of occupational task content by race in the United States, 1900-2021. Black workers began the transition to better paid, cognitiveintensive modern jobs at least a generation after white workers; substantial convergence only occurred after 1960. Longitudinal data suggests that task transitions were racially biased: Black men moved to jobs with lower rewarded task content than white men, conditional on initial tasks, though gaps decreased after 1940. Routine-intensive Black workers were less likely to move up into non-routine analytic work in all periods. The results suggest that task-displacement shocks widen Black-white inequality.
abstract_zh: 我们提供了关于美国1900至2021年间按种族划分的职业任务内容长期演变的新证据。黑人劳动者向薪酬更高、认知密集型现代职业的转变至少比白人劳动者晚了一代人；显著的趋同现象直到1960年后才出现。纵向数据表明，任务转换存在种族偏见：在初始任务条件相同的情况下，黑人男性转向的任务内容回报低于白人男性，尽管这一差距在1940年后有所缩小。在所有时期，从事常规密集型工作的黑人劳动者晋升至非常规分析性工作的可能性都较低。研究结果表明，任务替代冲击加剧了黑人与白人之间的不平等。
title: Tasks and Black-white Inequality over the Long Twentieth Century
title_zh: 长期二十世纪中的任务与黑白不平等

abstract: This paper investigates the effect of land property rights on rural household welfare and resilience outcomes by using large panel data on the rollout of China’s large-scale land certification program. While the program increases households’ consumption, income, assets, and resilience scores, we find no effects on health outcome (proxied by household expenditure on health and self-reported physical health of the household head). Our heterogeneity analysis suggests that the program increases household consumption and resilience across both male- and female-headed households as well as poor and nonpoor households. We identify agricultural investments, access to credit, land rental market participation, and labor allocation as potential mechanisms through which the land certification program affects household welfare and resilience outcomes. Our findings suggest that land property rights reform could be another effective strategy to alleviate poverty in line with the poverty trap hypothesis.
abstract_zh: 本文利用中国大规模土地确权项目推行的面板数据，研究了土地产权对农村家庭福利和韧性结果的影响。尽管该项目增加了家庭的消费、收入、资产和韧性评分，但我们发现其对健康结果（以家庭医疗支出和户主自报身体健康状况为代理指标）没有影响。异质性分析表明，该项目提高了男性和女性户主家庭以及贫困和非贫困家庭的消费和韧性。我们识别出农业投资、信贷获取、土地租赁市场参与和劳动力配置是土地确权项目影响家庭福利和韧性结果的潜在机制。我们的研究结果表明，土地产权改革可能是另一种符合贫困陷阱假说的有效减贫策略。
